title: End Portal & Dragon changes
subtitle: Try speedrunning it anyways
description: End remastered is present, requiring the end portal to have 12 different unique ender eyes obtained from various structures to activate.
This should hopefully delay access to the end and make it a group effort!
Alongside this, ender trigon is installed making the dragon fight much more difficult.
So you'd want multiple people fairly geared up to take this on (especially since dying will do alot to your gear durability)
